name: ruview-live
description: RuView live sensing in Claude Code: /ruview opens a pane beside the transcript with your CSI nodes (ESP32, Realtek) and 60 GHz radar (raw or ESPHome kits): rates, loss, RSSI, presence, device-reported vitals and alerts such as heartbeat-only boards, refreshed on a timer, plus a one-line status. Reads only; runs the @ruvnet/ruview CLI it ships beside.

udpPort.title: UDP port
udpPort.description: Port your CSI nodes stream to (the sensing server's default is 5005). The pane listens briefly on each refresh; it reports port_in_use when the sensing server holds it.

radarHost.title: Radar kit host
radarHost.description: IP or hostname of an ESPHome radar kit (e.g. a Seeed MR60BHA2) on your private network. Empty skips the radar.

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh interval (s)
refreshSeconds.description: Seconds between refreshes while the pane is open (minimum 5).

captureSeconds.title: Capture window (s)
captureSeconds.description: Seconds each refresh listens for node packets and radar states (1-10).
